Aisha Khan: Heads up 18: vendor CSV import triggered ~120 invites with inverted opt-out semantics and wrong locale defaults. Compliance flagged it.
Noah Park: Oof. Which columns?
Aisha Khan: locale set to en-GB by default, and opt_out_email uses 0=opt-out, 1=opt-in (we assume opposite).
Maya Rodriguez: That'll send reminders in the wrong language and opt people back in. Need immediate mitigation.
Noah Park: Is this from last night's bulk job job_id=2026-03-22-03:14?
Aisha Khan: Yes. Sample row: ```candidate_email,locale,opt_out_email
jane@example.com,en-GB,0
```
Samir Patel: Confirmed. Quick plan: 1) Pause reminder queue. 2) Generate impacted list for comms/legal. 3) Backfill normalized locale + opt_out. 4) Add vendor-specific hotfix & CI validation.
Recruiting Bot: :warning: 118 invites sent (job 2026-03-22-03:14). Delivery 100%.
Noah Park: Pausing reminder queue now. Snapshotting queue & DB.
Samir Patel: Running query to enumerate candidates: SELECT id,email,locale,opt_out_email FROM candidates WHERE source_vendor='greenfield' AND created_at>='2026-03-22'; (est 118 rows).
Maya Rodriguez: Draft comms in #people-ops-drafts: "Hi X 11: We sent invites with incorrect language or email settings. We've fixed it and apologize. Reply to opt-out." Sending after legal review.
Samir Patel: Hotfix: importer will invert opt_out when vendor='greenfield' and enforce locale whitelist (en-US,en-GB,fr-FR). Adding unit + integration tests to CI.
Noah Park: After patch we'll re-run import in staging and run a sanity script.
Samir Patel: Dry-run shows 118/118 normalized. Ready to deploy once legal approves comms.
Aisha Khan: Vendor acknowledged schema mismatch and will send corrected feed by EOD.
Maya Rodriguez: Logging this as an incident for the monthly ops review and prepping RCA notes.
Noah Park: Retro item: require vendor schema contract and sample CSV during onboarding.
Aisha Khan: Tasks assigned: Samir - patch/tests; Noah - queue + verification; Maya - comms; Aisha - vendor escalation. Blocking until vendor confirms corrected feed. :thumbsup:
